issues.what: Output-plate spin is not visually confirmable: 6-hole symmetry plus a weak landmark on the green plate. Disc-to-pin walk is the readable motion.

motion_reads_as: Red cycloidal disc walks and precesses around the fixed blue pin ring while the gold eccentric orbits; housing stays put across the 3960 deg input sweep.
notes: meta lists output_plate stationary with ~0 centroid travel, expected for spin-in-place. Last column at 3326 deg is still approaching 3960=0. Red showing through output holes is designed pin-hole contact.
